long_biography.plain_text:
Growing up in South Sumatra, Yessi Maya Sari won a scholarship to study economics at the University of Indonesia. She qualified in accounting and began her career with Johnson & Johnson before moving into marketing at Unilever and L’Oréal. Travel through Indonesia's island regions changed her priorities: she wanted to turn access to remote reefs and communities into a carefully managed visitor experience.

With Kevin Corcoran, Sari founded Coral Triangle Safaris and developed its charter operation in eastern Indonesia. She took an active part in designing the guest experience and has served as cruise director, combining on-the-ground hosting with creative oversight. The company organises tailored voyages that pair marine exploration with local guides and Indonesian food.
long_biography.html:
Growing up in South Sumatra, Yessi Maya Sari won a scholarship to study economics at the University of Indonesia. She qualified in accounting and began her career with Johnson & Johnson before moving into marketing at Unilever and L’Oréal. Travel through Indonesia's island regions changed her priorities: she wanted to turn access to remote reefs and communities into a carefully managed visitor experience.

With Kevin Corcoran, Sari founded Coral Triangle Safaris and developed its charter operation in eastern Indonesia. She took an active part in designing the guest experience and has served as cruise director, combining on-the-ground hosting with creative oversight. The company organises tailored voyages that pair marine exploration with local guides and Indonesian food.
